_note: Act-transition healers (js/engine/healer.js picks one per act, js/ui/healer.js shows it). Icons must exist in assets/icons-hd. `acts` = acts this healer greets after (empty/absent = default pool).

healers.name: Uther the Lightbringer
healers.title: First Paladin of the Silver Hand
lines: Well fought, friend. A true champion of the Light never fights alone.
Hold your head high. I have seen worse odds, and I have seen them broken.
The Light will always shine upon those whose cause is just.
Stand resolute. Even in the deepest shadows, our faith illuminates the path.
healers.heal: Uther lays a hand upon you. The Light knits your deepest wounds.

healers.name: Priestess of Elune
healers.title: Handmaiden of the Moon
lines: Elune watches over you, wanderer. Let her silver light wash the weariness away.
The moon is full tonight. Be still, and be healed.
healers.heal: Moonlight soothes your wounds. You breathe easier.
